rust_summary: a GUI triangle-fan Host helper backed by existing six-vertex quads in `native_item_slot.rs`.
doc_summary: `fan(batch, center, edge, argb)` emits one triangle for each adjacent pair of GUI edge points, using `[center, a, b, b]` quads. Fewer than two edge points emit nothing. The boundary is open: repeat the first point at the end for a closed fan. Existing quad clipping/scaling can be used without a new rendering pipeline. Bundles need the @API:gui_fan@ hook requirement.
